claude_path.description: Full path to the claude executable. Leave empty to find it in PATH.
claude_path.label: Claude binary path

default_cwd.description: Folder where Claude starts a new chat.
default_cwd.label: Working folder

effort.description: How much reasoning effort Claude uses. Default uses the model setting.
effort.label: Effort

extra_prompt.description: Text added to the system prompt of every chat.
extra_prompt.label: Extra instructions

load_user_config.description: Use your own CLAUDE.md, settings and MCP servers from ~/.claude.
load_user_config.label: Load my Claude config

model.description: Which Claude model answers. Default uses your Claude Code setting.
model.label: Model

notify_on_completion.description: Show a notification when Claude finishes or reports an error while the panel is closed.
notify_on_completion.label: Notify when finished

notify_on_permission.description: Show a notification when Claude waits for your approval while the panel is closed.
notify_on_permission.label: Notify on permission requests

permission_mode.description: Default: Bypass runs tools without approval. Ask requests approval; Accept edits allows file edits; Plan is read-only.
permission_mode.label: Permission mode

python_path.description: Full path to python3 for the bridge. Leave empty to use PATH.
python_path.label: Python path

send_on_enter.description: Enter sends the message and Shift+Enter adds a new line. Off: Ctrl+Enter sends.
send_on_enter.label: Send on Enter

suggestion_accept.description: Key that inserts the highlighted suggestion. Enter picks only while suggestions are shown and sends or adds a line otherwise. If one key is chosen twice, picking wins over moving.
suggestion_accept.label: Pick suggestion

suggestion_next.description: Key that moves the highlight down in the command and file suggestions.
suggestion_next.label: Next suggestion

suggestion_previous.description: Key that moves the highlight up in the command and file suggestions.
suggestion_previous.label: Previous suggestion
